$comment: Shared project settings, committed on purpose. `.claude/` is otherwise gitignored because it
holds git worktrees and a skills symlink pointing outside the repository; `.gitignore`
re-includes this one file so the rules below reach every clone rather than living in one
Standing rule, authorised by Mike Famulare on 2026-07-30: git and gh operations are allowed
without a per-call prompt. This is a workflow decision, not a licence to be careless. The
judgement calls that still apply, because a permission allowlist cannot make them:
- branch before committing if you are on main;
- force-push, history rewrite, and branch deletion are destructive and still warrant saying
what you are about to do first;
- `final/` and `raw/` are immutable release trees. No git operation should rewrite them, and
a diff that touches them is a bug until proven otherwise;
- opening or merging a PR publishes work. Allowed, but say so plainly when you do it.
